class RayPrometheusMetric:
    # Set to a dict on a labeled child produced by ``labels()``. ``None`` marks
    # an unlabeled parent metric.
    _tags: dict[str, str] | None = None

    def __init__(self):
        if ray_metrics is None:
            raise ImportError("RayPrometheusMetric requires Ray to be installed.")
        self.metric: Metric = None
        self._tags = None

    @staticmethod
    def _get_tag_keys(labelnames: list[str] | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        labels = list(labelnames) if labelnames else []
        labels.append("ReplicaId")
        return tuple(labels)

    @property
    def _effective_tags(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Tags forwarded to the underlying Ray metric.

        Labeled children carry their own ``_tags``. Unlabeled metrics still need
        to supply the automatically-added ``ReplicaId`` tag.
        """
        if self._tags is not None:
            return self._tags
        return {"ReplicaId": _get_replica_id() or ""}

    def labels(self, *labels, **labelskwargs):
        # ``labels()`` may only be called on an unlabeled parent metric.
        if self._tags is not None:
            raise ValueError("labels() called on an already-labeled metric")

        # The declared tag keys always include the auto-added ``ReplicaId``.
        label_names = [key for key in self.metric._tag_keys if key != "ReplicaId"]

        if labels:
            if len(labels) != len(label_names):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Number of labels must match the number of label names. "
                    f"Expected {len(label_names)}, got {len(labels)}"
                )
            labelskwargs.update(zip(label_names, labels))

        # Build an independent copy of the tags for this child, coercing every
        # value to a string.
        tags = {key: str(value) for key, value in labelskwargs.items()}
        tags["ReplicaId"] = _get_replica_id() or ""

        # Each call returns a new, independent child so labeled metrics do not
        # share mutable state.
        child = copy.copy(self)
        child._tags = tags
        return child

    def _get_sanitized_opentelemetry_name(name: str) -> str:
        """
        For compatibility with Ray + OpenTelemetry, the metric name must be
        sanitized. In particular, this replaces disallowed character (e.g., ':')
        with '_' in the metric name.
        Allowed characters: a-z, A-Z, 0-9, _

        Ref: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-cpp/blob/main/sdk/src/metrics/instrument_metadata_validator.cc#L22-L23
        Ref: https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/master/src/ray/stats/metric.cc#L107

        return re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_", name)
